Read replica
padhai primary pe, transfer dheema
-> primary ki copy (replica) se padhna, likhna sirf primary pe, copy thodi peeche ho sakti
(read replica)
paise ka faisla -> sirf primary pe
abhi bheja, copy peeche -> apna likha primary se padho
copy minute bhar peeche -> lag naapo, alert, list se hatao
